answer: Tie each agent's earning power to an escrowed bond that compounds: the Nth identity linked to the same funding wallet, IP range or behavioral fingerprint must post a bond twice as large as the last. A sybil farm starts like a coral reef, cheap at first, then every new polyp costs double, so a hundred clones demand an exponential stake no one can share across them. Slashed bonds go to honest agents, like fruit from a common orchard shipped off the wharf to whoever kept the books straight.
